geometry.description: Fresh marginally isotropic unit local addresses per episode and reset group. Correlated addresses normalize sqrt(a)*u_group + sqrt(1-a)*e_fact; a is a mixing coefficient, not the realized dot product.

grid.tau_rule: unique values from [1, 2, h] satisfying tau <= h

selection.cost_description: mixed primitive-operation proxy: J*(3*p*v+v) local write operations + C*D*p*v state-build MAC + Q*(D*p*v+p*v) read MAC
selection.memory_description: p*v + D*p*v folded-inference scalars; supplied address generation, oracle routes, and metadata are excluded
